blueprint.name: CybersecurityProduct
blueprint.description: A cybersecurity product and its demonstrated behavior

capabilities.description: Threats or suspicious behavior detected by the product

response.description: Action taken after a threat is detected

values.name: Sentinel Harbor
values.capabilities: Detects suspicious network activity and credential theft attempts.
values.response: Automatically isolates compromised endpoints from the network.
values.evidence: In a controlled evaluation, it blocked credential theft and lateral movement.

values.name: Aegis Lantern
values.capabilities: Detects malicious email attachments and phishing links.
values.response: Quarantines the message and alerts the security team.
values.evidence: In a controlled evaluation, it stopped a simulated invoice phishing campaign.
